name: UniTracks
description: Cross-platform sport tracking app built with .NET MAUI, focused on data security and privacy — all data stays on your device, with no cloud and no tracking. Record GPS trips with live speed, altitude and accuracy, choose from 85+ trip types, and watch your route color by pace. Gamification with levels, XP, streaks and badges, plus a cozy isometric city builder you build with earned coins.
author: Agredo Application
